correctness.rationale: Under atomless i.i.d. sampling every relative order on a window union is equiprobable, and disjoint windows give zero cross-covariance. Summing all ordered lags with finite-sample multiplicities K and (K−h)_+ gives the asserted limiting covariance, unchanged by using K=n−3 rather than n as divisor. Independent linear-extension subset recursion for two chain constraints (`python /workspace/branches/replay_ordinal.py`) reconstructs the integer D and matches the full characteristic polynomial in exact arithmetic, with trace 17064. A separate exact Newton trace calculation agrees. The zero multiplicity is six, and positive semidefiniteness of the covariance makes the other 18 roots positive. The finite-dependent vector CLT and continuous mapping give 24 times the covariance eigenvalues, hence r/840 as stated. This is an asymptotic test law, not finite-sample calibration. The frozen verifier was inspected, not executed.
